title: Missing authorization in PostgreSQL logical replication allows a compromised publisher to execute arbitrary code as…
description: A missing authorization vulnerability in PostgreSQL logical replication allows a compromised publisher to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running a superuser-owned subscription. This affects only subscriptions owned by superusers. Versions prior to PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are vulnerable.
